## Agenda

- 19:30  Recap: Session 6
- 19:40  7.1  Protocol, ethics, consent, registration, feasibility
- 20:10  7.2  Research integrity: authorship, conflicts of interest, data sharing, AI
- 20:30  Proposal builder 7: ethics and publication plan
- 21:00  7.3  Writing the paper (I): Methods, Results, tables, STROBE
- 21:35  Manuscript workshop 1: Methods and Results, together then on your own

## Timetable

| Start | Clock* | Min | Segment |
|:----|:----|---:|:------------------------------------------------------------|
| 0:00 | 19:30 | 10 | Recap quiz |
| 0:10 | 19:40 | 30 | **7.1 Protocol, ethics and consent:** protocol (SPIRIT), Helsinki & GCP, ethics committee journey, registration, consent incl. ICU consent, confidentiality, feasibility |
| 0:40 | 20:10 | 20 | **7.2 Research integrity:** FFP, duplicate/salami, authorship, conflicts of interest, data sharing, AI use; scenario poll |
| 1:00 | 20:30 | 15 | **Proposal builder 7:** modelled live (ethics, registration, feasibility, publication plan); participants draft their own Part 4 as homework |
| 1:15 | 20:45 | 15 | BREAK |
| 1:30 | 21:00 | 35 | **7.3 Writing the paper (I):** writing order, Methods (incl. statistical paragraph), Results (participants first, numbers with CIs, no interpretation), stand-alone tables & figures, STROBE for the course-dataset paper |
| 2:05 | 21:35 | 45 | **[DS] Manuscript workshop 1:** the instructor drafts Methods + Results for Q1 live with the class (30 min); each participant then starts the Methods + Results (~600 words) for their chosen question, with Table 1 and one figure/table from its results pack (15 min, finished as homework) |
| 2:50 | 22:20 | 10 | Key words, wrap-up, exit question, homework |

\*Times are relative to the start of the session; the clock column shows Vietnam time for the online 19:30–22:30 session. All exercises are done by the whole class together (no groups). **[DS]** = course-dataset content (FLUID-ICU analysis and manuscript writing).

## Before this session

- Proposal Part 3 finished; slides started.
- Your chosen question (Q1 to Q5), its results pack and Table 1 at hand for the manuscript workshop.

## After this session (homework)

- **Your proposal:** finish Proposal Part 4 and your 6 slides. If you would like to present in Session 8, tell the course lead by Wednesday.
- **Your manuscript:** draft the Methods + Results for your question, as modelled on Q1 in class.
- Read the abstracts of Papers 1 and 2 before Session 8 (for *Be the reviewer*).
- The integrity scenarios on the Session 7 sheet that were not done in class.
